strengths: Correctly recognizes the dominant ECM/mesenchymal-stromal signature
Correctly excludes neuronal, glial, epithelial, endothelial and immune lineages from the marker panel
weaknesses: CL:0000134 is non-hierarchical to fibroblast; the marker panel lacks direct stemness/multipotency evidence
COL1A1, COL3A1, FN1, LUM, DCN, POSTN and SPARC are shared with fibroblasts and do not specifically select the MSC branch

strengths: Directly supported by canonical fibroblast/ECM markers COL1A1, COL3A1, COL1A2, FN1, LUM, DCN, BGN, POSTN, SPARC and VIM
Avoids unsupported anatomical or stemness specificity and matches the observed matrix-producing phenotype
weaknesses: Does not further refine the myofibroblast-like contractile component (TAGLN, CALD1, TPM2) into a subtype label

strengths: Identifies the stromal/ECM-producing nature of the cluster using classic ECM markers
weaknesses: No endometrium-specific evidence (e.g., ESR1, PGR, DKK1, FOXO1) or tissue context supports CL:0002255
Over-specific relative to the generic fibroblast/stromal marker panel

supporting: COL1A1, COL3A1, COL1A2, FN1, LUM, DCN, BGN, POSTN, SPARC and VIM are canonical fibroblast/ECM-producing markers directly supporting the fibroblast branch
TAGLN, CALD1, TPM1 and TPM2 are consistent with a contractile fibroblast/myofibroblast-like state within the fibroblast identity
conflicting: No direct MSC-specific stemness markers are present to support CL:0000134
No endometrial-specific markers or tissue evidence support CL:0002255
enrichment_or_literature: Original enrichment output (extracellular matrix organization, collagen fibril organization, ECM-receptor interaction) is consistent with fibroblast identity

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
